intentEvidence: The plugin supports you to save files in any Webdav access support network disk or cloud storage.
motivation: We often need to save some of the files specialized in each software, it is not convenient to Obsidian management.
problem: Managing specialized files stored in external cloud or network storage is inconvenient within Obsidian.
summary: Webdav File Explorer allows users to browse and reference files stored in WebDAV locations, creating local symmetric Markdown file trees.
